title: Would you survive a hang glider losing lift over a cliff? #shorts
description: The wind that was holding you up suddenly isn't there anymore, and the ground is coming up fast. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if your hang glider suddenly lost lift over a cliff edge?
script: You're soaring along a ridge line when the updraft that was carrying you vanishes without warning, a wind shift stealing the lift out from under your wing. The glider noses down and airspeed builds fast as you drop toward the rocks below. Pulling the control bar back too hard stalls the wing completely at the worst possible height. You don't survive.

You don't survive.

title: Would you survive your scuba regulator failing at depth? #shorts
description: You go to breathe and nothing comes through the mouthpiece, sixty feet below the surface. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if your regulator suddenly stopped delivering air underwater?
script: You're sixty feet down when your next breath pulls nothing but resistance through the regulator, a failure in the air delivery system cutting you off mid-dive. Instead of panicking, you signal your buddy and take their spare regulator, breathing off their tank as you both begin a slow, controlled ascent together. You surface a few minutes later, rattled but breathing fine air. You survive.

You surface together. You survive.

title: Would you survive getting tangled in a shark net offshore? #shorts
description: The mesh wraps around your leg and pulling only tightens it further as the current pulls you under. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if you got tangled in a shark net while swimming?
script: You're swimming past the marked swim zone when your leg catches in the loose mesh of a submerged shark net, meant to snag large animals, not people. Struggling instinctively only wraps the netting tighter around your ankle, so instead you force yourself still, work the mesh loose strand by strand with your hands, and signal for help on the surface between breaths. A lifeguard reaches you before the current pulls you under. You survive.
captions: Your leg catches in submerged mesh netting.

title: Would you survive an angry bison charging you? #shorts

hook: What would happen if a bison suddenly charged at you?
script: You got closer than you meant to for a photo, and the bison's head drops, tail flicks up, the two warning signs right before it charges. A bison can run three times faster than a human sprints, so outrunning it in the open is not an option. title: Would you survive standing on an ice shelf as it starts to break apart? #shorts
description: The ice under your boots groans, then splits into a crack running straight toward you. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if the ice shelf you were standing on suddenly started collapsing?
script: You're crossing a wide sheet of shelf ice when a low groan rises from underneath, and a crack races across the surface faster than you can outrun it. Instead of running upright, you drop flat and spread your weight, crawling toward thicker, whiter ice away from the fracture line. The section behind you tips into the water, but the ice under you holds. You survive.

title: Would you survive a dust explosion inside a grain elevator? #shorts
description: A spark near the conveyor ignites the air itself, and the whole structure goes up in a chain reaction. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if the grain dust in the elevator around you suddenly ignited?
script: Fine grain dust hangs thick in the air of the elevator, invisible enough that you barely notice it until a spark from a jammed conveyor belt sets it off. Unlike a normal fire, a dust explosion ignites the air itself in a fraction of a second, and the shockwave kicks up even more dust that ignites again in a chain reaction that can level an entire structure floor by floor. The blast wave reaches your level before you find the stairwell. You don't survive.

title: Would you survive a flash flood inside a coal mine? #shorts
description: Water breaks through an old flooded tunnel and starts rising through the shaft fast. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if water suddenly flooded the mine tunnel you were working in?
script: A drilling crew breaks through into an old abandoned tunnel that's been silently filling with groundwater for decades, and thousands of gallons come rushing through the breach at once. The water rises through the lower shaft fast, cutting off the main exit route within minutes. You move immediately toward the higher tunnels instead of the flooding exit, reach a sealed refuge chamber stocked with air, and wait as rescue crews drill through from the surface. You survive.
